INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Rain of Fire, Hellfire and Death Coil Warlock builds

Last updated: November 11, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Tengil’s three Warlock plans each choose a different spell to receive most of the upgrades. All three use a full 51-point tree, an eight-piece Field Marshal PvP set and Atiesh. Pick the build before the run so that the spell slots, ring and upgrade priorities work together.

Choose the spell you want to scale

Build and talent splitWhat to keep in the upgrade poolJewelry decision
Rain of Fire · 2 Affliction / 31 Demonology / 18 DestructionKeep Rain of Fire, Hellfire and Demonic Empowerment. Use Rain of Fire for the main investment and Hellfire for added coverage once the ground effects reach enough of the pack.Quick Strike Ring is the cooldown slot. Use the critical-chance ring when Quick Strike has no useful offer.
Infernal Hellfire · 5 / 28 / 18Keep Hellfire, Soulfire and Demonic Empowerment. If the displayed Hellfire interval stops improving, compare Soulfire with the next damage or area offer.This route equips Band of Accuria in place of Quick Strike. Tengil uses a strong Demonic Empowerment offer to cover its cooldown.
Death Coil · 20 / 31 / 0Draft Death Coil and Drain Life. Give Coil the extra targets and cooldown it needs, then consider Drain Life when its offer is stronger.Start with Quick Strike and check the spell’s displayed critical chance before moving investment into critical damage.

Keep the necklace decision simple

The Eye of Hakkar appears in all three plans. If it is already working and you have invested ranks in it, compare the effect and lost investment before switching to a later necklace. Tengil lists Choker of Enlightenment as a fallback in the Death Coil plan.

Fill the remaining spell slots

Both the Rain of Fire and Hellfire routes add Death Coil, Immolate and Shadow Bolt to the three main spells above. In both plans those extra spells are marked for banishment. The Death Coil route adds Demonic Empowerment, Fear, Immolate and Shadow Bolt to Death Coil and Drain Life. The opening Death Coil setup marks Fear, Immolate and Shadow Bolt for banishment. Check the stage tab in the original plan before committing, since the marked spells change later. Use the live tooltip to verify cooldown behavior in your run.
